title: EOMasters Newsletter #023
description: A hand-picked selection of news from the field of EO and RS
html:
EOMasters Newsletter #023

05/05/2024

Hello EO-Masters!

After the release of SNAP 10 I have now released the EOMasters Toolbox and the DAVALIEN plugin. 🎉🎉

This is like a milestone for me. And that's the reason this is the only news in this Issue. 🙂

In this Issue:

EOMasters News

  • EOMTB and DAVALIEN Are Out Now

EOMasters News

EOMTBX and DAVALIEN Are Out Now

As a fellow EOMasters follower, you've probably seen my introductions to these two plugins. But if not...

The first release of the EOMasters Toolbox contains the following features:

  • Quick Menu

  • Loop GPT

  • Band Maths Extensions

  • Wavelength Editor

  • Close Product Without a View

  • Generate System Report

These features are explained inf the Blog article and in a video on YouTube.

The 𝘿𝘼ta 𝙑𝘼𝙇𝙄dation 𝙀𝙉vironment provides an environment for validating EO data and is intended for quality assurance of EO data and data processing software.

I also prepared a blog to provide a brief introduction.

I would be grateful if you could give me your feedback. Tell me what features you would like to see. How can they be improved to better meet your needs?

In the articles it is mentioned where you can provide your feedback. Thank you.

  • EOMasters Toolbox v1.0 Released - An Introduction

  • Introducing EOMasters Toolbox (youtube.com)

  • DAVALIEN v1.0 released - An Introduction

Newsletter Archive

For past editions of this newsletter, you can visit the archive.

That's it for this issue. I hope you enjoyed this collection of news. Stay tuned for the next edition, which will arrive in your inbox in about two weeks.

Tschüss and Goodbye!

Marco
